productBugs.summary: On 067c1646 a profile photo that is still large after the browser resizes it (here a 512x512 detailed PNG stored as a ~1 MB data URL) saves with Saved, but afterwards Settings > Profile shows Something went wrong. The page could not load. The session endpoint GET /api/auth/get-session answers with a set-auth-jwt response header that carries the whole photo (about 1.4 MB measured on the lab), which Chromium refuses (ERR_RESPONSE_HEADERS_TOO_BIG). Home and other pages still load; the person has no way to remove the photo. dev commit 7abd2a8f (PR #1158, after the pinned commit) stops the jwt plugin from sending set-auth-jwt.
